Landlord
Tenant

- Cheque 1 - 1 January 2027 - AED 21,250

- Cheque 3 - 1 July 2027 - AED 21,250

Payable to Sample Landlord LLC

- Admin fee AED 500 (tenant)

The rent above is fixed for the whole term. It can only change at renewal, with written notice given in time
under Dubai law.
This contract is registered in Ejari after both parties sign.

page of the signed copy.
